item.text: I’ll build the shaft and helical thread, then compare all four views to refine the proportions and orientation.

arguments.code:
core = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(20).extrude(64)
helix = cq.Wire.makeHelix(7,35,20)
profile = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(19.7,-1),(25,-0.65),(25,0.65),(19.7,1)]).close()
thread = profile.sweep(cq.Workplane(obj=helix), isFrenet=True).translate((0,0,14.5))
result = core.union(thread)
